about: Settings > Bin: the items deleted in the last 30 days, with Restore and Delete forever, and the 30-day purge. The delete already writes the item's last version to the bin (cloud.js onCommit); this reads those entries, brings one back and removes the old ones. Cloud app only. Local here until a second kind of app wants it.

files.line: { key: 'binOn', label: 'Bin', sub: 'Keep deleted items for 30 days. Every device; sign in to change it' },

docs: bin: Settings > Bin is app/src/screens/bin-settings.js (its label is the item's text: make it the app's own); entries past 30 days are purged when the page opens. The data side is app/src/bin-data.js (cloud.js app.bin = { list, restore, purge }); the delete-to-bin write is the template's own (cloud.js onCommit). A switch on Settings > Features (option binOn, account, on) hides the page and stops the copy on delete. The rule only adds the delete (app/rules/bin.rules).
